name: Financial Evidence Equivariance
status: prospective local pilot; not externally preregistered
primary_contrast: canonical_pointer minus native_amount paired usable accuracy on unit_rescale, retrieved_pages, base model, test companies
primary_metric: fraction of base/variant pairs with both numeric answers correct, denominator all questions
uncertainty: paired company-cluster bootstrap, 2000 resamples, seed 17; seven test companies
selection: none; publish all four arms and both models regardless of direction
hypotheses: H1: canonical pointer decoding improves paired usable accuracy under unit rescaling relative to native amount generation
H2: canonicalization alone explains some of any improvement; compare canonical_amount and canonical_pointer
H3: preserving-transform consistency can coexist with wrong answers; publish consistency and usable accuracy separately
H4: period rebinding and evidence removal expose failures hidden by preserving-transform consistency
limitations: Existing test companies were seen in earlier repository studies; this is a new frozen pilot, not a fresh independent holdout
Five metric families, ten semiconductor companies, FY2023 filings, source annotations pending independent human review
Typed cells come from existing extracted tables, not a new general PDF parser
Post-retrieval interventions do not measure reranking under a rebuilt mutated index
Both models are small members of one instruction-tuned family; no frontier-model claim
No new algorithm or first-ever novelty claim for cell selection, normalization, or metamorphic testing
